The Siren of Savere, Revine Zecrew, was an unusual ruler for an unusual land.
Revine Zecrew stared at Ceria as she obligingly tried to cram another Yellat into her mouth.
But she was alive, not eaten by a giant Creler, and, rather than being captive of a dangerous [Bandit Queen], it seemed like Revine was disposed to like her due to Illphres.
Revine hovered around it after Ceria had gone.

“I gifted the treasure via a Skill. That’s how a gang came to me. ‘Course, I took in two small lowland groups, but it wasn’t all my own talents. It’s a special Skill. You might’ve never heard of it, but we like to call them Yellat Skills. [Tribute to the Bandit Queen]—that’s it. Takes whatever I send straight to the Siren of Savere herself, the ruler of Savere. The [Bandit Queen].”
